text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: service=inference-gateway-east1 severity=high — automated page fired for http_5xx_rate spike (threshold breach 09:18 UTC)
oncall-eng: ACK — looking now. pulling logs from edge.
eng-jordan: seeing a rapid fanout of /v1/embeddings webhook calls from billing-webhook-queue -> spikes upstream TLS resets. sample: `502: upstream reset by peer` in nginx-ingress.
sre-amy: curious — any recent cert rotates or proxy restarts in east1?
eng-jordan: we rotated certs on auth-proxy ~09:10 for renewal, nginx logs show a lot of TLS handshake errors after that, clients retrying concurrently -> heavy connection churn.
oncall-eng: runbook step 1: throttle webhook consumer at ingress-level and shift traffic away from east1. doing `kubectl annotate svc inference-gateway rollout.k8s/reprovision=hold -n prod` and applying rate-limit rule.
eng-jordan: applying 50% route weight shift to us-west2 for inbound inference traffic (canary route). patching routing table now.
sre-amy: scaling up gateway pods in east1 to soak connections while we mitigate: `k scale deploy/gateway --replicas=8 -n prod`
oncall-eng: throttle applied, route weight shift in progress. error rate dropping from 1200rpm -> 300rpm within 30s.
pd-ops: note: PagerDuty escalation will proceed if next ack not received in 10m. keep me posted.
customer-success-lina: any customer impact? seeing 12 support tickets from EU customers about failed embeddings jobs. marking as potential customer-visible.
eng-jordan: temporary mitigation: enabled nginx upstream_keepalive=on and bumped proxy buffer to reduce TLS handshake churn. also reloaded auth-proxy with session-cache restored.
oncall-eng: Confirmed: 5xx rate trending down to normal baseline, overall latency stable. continuing to monitor for 15m.
sre-amy: follow-up checklist: create short post-incident note, include cert-rotation timing and webhook retry backoff recommendation for billing team.
eng-jordan: root cause hypothesis: cert rotation caused session-cache invalidation in auth-proxy -> large number of clients reconnected simultaneously -> upstream TLS renegotiation + webhook fanout amplified errors. recommend staggered cert rotation + client backoff.
customer-success-lina: alerted top 3 affected customers, offering retry guidance and apology.
oncall-eng: handing off to next oncall (sre-amy) for extended monitoring window. handoff_ts=1820000200 
sre-amy: ACK handoff. will watch for 1h then close. filing incident ticket and linking PD alert.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: incident PDR-1820 acknowledged by oncall-eng, status=mitigated, followup=postmortem required. :white_check_mark:
eng-jordan: saving collected logs and a grep of TLS errors for postmortem: ```nginx: 2026/09/22 09:11:03 [error] 1234#0: *98765 upstream prematurely closed connection while reading response header, client: 10.1.2.3, server: inference, request: "POST /v1/embeddings"```
sre-amy: adding action items: (1) add rate-limit on billing webhook queue, (2) add cert-rotation rollout orchestration, (3) add improved alerting threshold to include TLS handshake errors.
oncall-eng: closing active pager chain; leaving thread open for notes. :thumbsup:
